{{Top|leg}}
The '''agitators''' played a key role in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] by challenging public perception and inciting action against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. Many had once served the Empire but left after witnessing its atrocities firsthand. Whether their disillusionment came early or after [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of silence, it shaped their unwavering pursuit of justice.<ref name="Desperate Allies">''[[Desperate Allies]]''</ref>

Unlike [[Lawyer/Legends|advocates]], who worked within systems, agitators stirred emotions through bold demonstrations and impassioned speeches. Some rose from humble beginnings, organizing labor movements and gaining influence through charisma and collective bargaining. Others blended protest with performance, using art, [[Music/Legends|music]], or [[Graffiti/Legends|graffiti]] to inspire resistance. Their creativity and zeal made them powerful voices within the Rebel Alliance, rallying the oppressed and aiding fellow Rebels in the fight for freedom.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
Agitator was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
